queries.name: server_clean_stop
queries.statement: SELECT server_id,status,clean_stop,fencing_epoch,IF(lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),1,0) FROM ct_servers WHERE cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND server_id IN ('opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-A','opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-B','opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-C') ORDER BY server_id

queries.name: endpoint_checkpoints

queries.name: referenced_resources
queries.statement: SELECT r.resource_id,r.kind,r.format_version,r.payload_hash,CONCAT('hex:',HEX(r.payload)) FROM ct_resources r WHERE r.cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ct_transfers t WHERE t.cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND t.endpoint_id IN ('08ca7e43-32ab-4e0e-b34b-abf5a123102b','0fabb2a9-c1e4-4473-9559-0e0e42aa81e1','201960d5-e01b-4c1c-ae89-fc8dbacfc97c','267868f3-ed52-41fa-9b14-26890b03cddb','271dc606-d4f6-4345-89f5-4174136f15d5','405e9f1f-e982-4060-af64-b0d74bdd2d0c','4a061292-5c5f-480e-9a86-aebe0b75bb93','6c2f8315-73cd-4e6f-bdd6-4d9727f1533f','742a546d-6c92-4c36-8e5b-1def489981c7','7b463e85-b6f6-485b-abc6-0f06297768b1','8b69b6e8-8016-4628-b159-2e3a6344ef8c','8bc59597-1bf0-4031-9808-8e9bef6d579a','8dbac1ad-3608-40fa-9ee9-0d66b64a2ebd','98274972-a627-44f2-96cb-0d18c4233624','9dd7f6fe-fa16-4024-8249-2a98b42c7da0','b375e6b7-fd2e-4eaa-a33f-cdc779f9b711','c3cc7ee8-1184-41fd-837a-d89311204214','c69512e5-2d73-41b3-9000-ae9559f54636','ca4bbc0a-865d-40ba-8da0-a77cbbb0145f','edf941f5-8906-400a-9b4d-95a7504f8217') AND t.channel_id IN ('2211d637-cd35-4871-b1d4-4fc0f6bae1c3','2ebee4ce-3bbd-4fe6-b304-58169f5ae02a','42ce23e5-a354-4005-82f7-8f47e3fa9861','53424897-01c0-4151-8671-360002a6cdd1','9f104a10-4c68-44f4-b3aa-2b8f2be2ad9d','d1b20b7f-7585-47f5-a5f7-8b0e3396b07e') AND t.resource_id=r.resource_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ct_balances b WHERE b.cluster_id=r.cluster_id AND b.channel_id IN ('2211d637-cd35-4871-b1d4-4fc0f6bae1c3','2ebee4ce-3bbd-4fe6-b304-58169f5ae02a','42ce23e5-a354-4005-82f7-8f47e3fa9861','53424897-01c0-4151-8671-360002a6cdd1','9f104a10-4c68-44f4-b3aa-2b8f2be2ad9d','d1b20b7f-7585-47f5-a5f7-8b0e3396b07e') AND b.resource_id=r.resource_id)) ORDER BY r.resource_id

queries.name: pool
queries.statement: SELECT b.channel_id,b.resource_id,b.amount FROM ct_balances b WHERE b.cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND b.channel_id IN ('2211d637-cd35-4871-b1d4-4fc0f6bae1c3','2ebee4ce-3bbd-4fe6-b304-58169f5ae02a','42ce23e5-a354-4005-82f7-8f47e3fa9861','53424897-01c0-4151-8671-360002a6cdd1','9f104a10-4c68-44f4-b3aa-2b8f2be2ad9d','d1b20b7f-7585-47f5-a5f7-8b0e3396b07e') ORDER BY b.channel_id,b.resource_id

queries.name: transfer_stage_totals
queries.statement: SELECT t.channel_id,r.kind,t.kind,t.state,COUNT(*),SUM(t.amount),SUM(t.remaining) FROM ct_transfers t JOIN ct_resources r ON r.cluster_id=t.cluster_id AND r.resource_id=t.resource_id WHERE t.cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND t.endpoint_id IN ('08ca7e43-32ab-4e0e-b34b-abf5a123102b','0fabb2a9-c1e4-4473-9559-0e0e42aa81e1','201960d5-e01b-4c1c-ae89-fc8dbacfc97c','267868f3-ed52-41fa-9b14-26890b03cddb','271dc606-d4f6-4345-89f5-4174136f15d5','405e9f1f-e982-4060-af64-b0d74bdd2d0c','4a061292-5c5f-480e-9a86-aebe0b75bb93','6c2f8315-73cd-4e6f-bdd6-4d9727f1533f','742a546d-6c92-4c36-8e5b-1def489981c7','7b463e85-b6f6-485b-abc6-0f06297768b1','8b69b6e8-8016-4628-b159-2e3a6344ef8c','8bc59597-1bf0-4031-9808-8e9bef6d579a','8dbac1ad-3608-40fa-9ee9-0d66b64a2ebd','98274972-a627-44f2-96cb-0d18c4233624','9dd7f6fe-fa16-4024-8249-2a98b42c7da0','b375e6b7-fd2e-4eaa-a33f-cdc779f9b711','c3cc7ee8-1184-41fd-837a-d89311204214','c69512e5-2d73-41b3-9000-ae9559f54636','ca4bbc0a-865d-40ba-8da0-a77cbbb0145f','edf941f5-8906-400a-9b4d-95a7504f8217') AND t.channel_id IN ('2211d637-cd35-4871-b1d4-4fc0f6bae1c3','2ebee4ce-3bbd-4fe6-b304-58169f5ae02a','42ce23e5-a354-4005-82f7-8f47e3fa9861','53424897-01c0-4151-8671-360002a6cdd1','9f104a10-4c68-44f4-b3aa-2b8f2be2ad9d','d1b20b7f-7585-47f5-a5f7-8b0e3396b07e') GROUP BY t.channel_id,r.kind,t.kind,t.state ORDER BY t.channel_id,r.kind,t.kind,t.state

queries.name: server_session_epoch
queries.statement: SELECT server_id,world_id,session_id,fencing_epoch,status,clean_stop,IF(lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),1,0) FROM ct_servers WHERE cluster_id='dev_three_v1' AND server_id IN ('opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-A','opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-B','opt-rc-soak-v2-3647-full2-C') ORDER BY server_id

scope: Independent stopped-terminal read-only asset reconciliation; original full2 failure/gates are unchanged.
Input/output debt is external accepted minus actual output, with zero period-start net assets. SQL exclusive ownership is pool plus positive ALLOCATE remaining; WAL/BE mirrors are not added.
No startup, RCON, asset mutation, refund, schema change or config modification.
Mode evidence is last acknowledged workload command, not an independent stopped-NBT decode. Unsaved uncommitted BE assets are not inferred from historic samples.
